note: A synthetic client (Slice 129 worked example). Not a real company.
problem: We are a home insurance broker. We want to know where our handling of personal data falls short of the data protection law and our privacy policy.

answers.common.decision: Which fixes to make first; the data protection officer decides.
answers.common.audience: The data protection officer and the executive team.
answers.common.materials: We received 240 subject access requests last year, and 36 were answered after the one-month legal deadline. Our customer database holds 400,000 records, of which 140,000 belong to customers inactive for longer than our six-year retention period. We found 3 marketing lists shared with an agency without a data processing agreement.
answers.risk-audit-controls.framework: The data protection law that applies to us and our privacy policy.
answers.risk-audit-controls.scope: Subject access requests, customer data retention and data shared with agencies, last year.
